issues: User-entered wizard 'label' (pathb-label input) is stored under meta.label in vps_deployments but the deployment card in the DEPLOYMENT JOBS list only shows deployment_id + path + region — the human-friendly label the user typed is never surfaced. Minor UX polish: show meta.label alongside deployment_id.

The card expanded 10 rows by default; the failure-matrix-toggle button toggles visibility both ways — behavior is fine but the button label doesn't change between expanded/collapsed state (both cases just say the same header). Minor.

critical_code_review_comments: infra_routes.terminal_decision maps ValueError to 404 only when 'not found' substring is present, otherwise 400 — fine but relies on error-message string matching. Prefer typed exceptions for stability.

infra_routes.ack_agent_command maps ValueError to 401 when the substring 'agent' is present, else 404. This is fragile; consider a small enum of error kinds returned by vps_pathb.ack_command so the HTTP layer doesn't sniff strings.

GET /api/infra/artifacts/manifest is intentionally public (no auth). The SHA-256 is fine to publish, but consider adding a Cache-Control header and an ETag so agents can conditionally fetch during rollout.

POST /api/infra/agent/register accepts either bootstrap_token or enrollment_code but there is no audit_log write on invalid attempts — for a security-sensitive one-time credential, log failures (both bogus token and bogus enrollment) with source IP.

vps_deployments doc does not store the human-entered label at top-level (only inside meta.label). The UI listing never surfaces the label, so users cannot identify their own VPS entries. Recommend hoisting meta.label -> label on write, or updating the UI to render meta.label.
PathBPanels failure-matrix-card renders 10 rows in a fixed grid; consider virtualizing / collapsing if the matrix grows beyond ~20 rows in future iterations.
